updateCadence: Re-patches each Chromium stable release; multiple updates per month
summary: A patch set that strips Google integration and telemetry from Chromium. No sync, no blocker bundled, no auto-updater; binaries mostly from community sources.
bestFor: Chromium users who want no Google calls
Linux users who like patch-set transparency
People who want Chromium behaviour without Google services
notFor: Users needing sync or built-in blocking

pros.title: No Google services
pros.detail: Removes Google API keys, Safe Browsing, sync and telemetry calls.

pros.title: Chromium compatibility
pros.detail: Same engine and DevTools as Chromium.

pros.title: Transparent patches
pros.detail: All changes are open on GitHub under BSD-3.

pros.title: Fast upstream tracking (Linux)
pros.detail: 156.0.8078.73-1 shipped on Oct 28, 2026, days after Chromium 156.

pros.title: Flexible flags
pros.detail: Adds extra privacy flags and runtime switches.

cons.title: No auto-update
cons.detail: Updating is manual or via a package manager; Windows builds lagged on 155.0.8059.84.

cons.title: No built-in blocking
cons.detail: Needs uBlock Origin Lite or similar; MV2 uBO unavailable on current Chromium.

cons.title: No sync or Widevine
cons.detail: No cross-device sync and no DRM out of the box.

cons.title: Rough edges
cons.detail: No official installer; Chrome Web Store access requires a helper extension.

faq.a: It strips Google services but you lose Safe Browsing and auto-update, so security depends on updating promptly.
The MV2 uBO does not run on current Chromium; uBlock Origin Lite (MV3) works.

faq.q: Where do I get Windows builds?
faq.a: From the project's listed community binaries; recent Windows build found was 155.0.8059.84-1.1.

switching.note: Chromium-based; import from other browsers through Chromium import UI.

spec.codecs: Depends on build; AV1, VP9, optional H.264/HEVC
spec.patchLag: Days on Linux; Windows and macOS binaries can lag a major

privacyDefaults: No Google services, but no blocker
tabManagement: Tab groups, search, no native vertical

unverified: Whether MV2 can still be re-enabled via patches in 156
Exact store availability (winget, flathub) for community builds
